description: This file defines classes and functions for IVR (Interactive Voice Response) navigation within a larger voice automation system. It includes an Enum for IVR statuses, a FrameProcessor subclass for processing LLM responses and XML command patterns, and a Pipeline subclass that manages IVR mode detection and navigation behavior, including event handling.

classes.name: IVRStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of IVR navigation status values, indicating the current state of IVR detection, completion, or issues.

classes.name: IVRProcessor
classes.description: A FrameProcessor subclass responsible for handling IVR navigation commands, including parsing DTMF tones, IVR statuses, and mode switching, using XML pattern aggregation and event callbacks.

classes.name: IVRNavigator
classes.description: A Pipeline subclass that orchestrates IVR detection and navigation, integrating an LLM service with the IVRProcessor, managing context frames, and issuing events on mode detection and IVR status changes.

methods.name: None update_saved_messages(self, messages: List[dict])
methods.description: Stores or updates the list of context messages for mode switching purposes.

methods.name: List[dict] _get_conversation_history(self)
methods.description: Returns the saved messages excluding the initial system message, representing user and assistant interactions.

methods.name: _setup_xml_patterns(self)
methods.description: Initializes XML tag patterns and corresponding handlers for command extraction.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling start, text, and end frames, and performing pattern aggregation.

methods.name: _handle_dtmf_action(self, match: PatternMatch)
methods.description: Handles detected DTMF commands, converting them into output frames and textual annotations.

methods.name: _handle_ivr_action(self, match: PatternMatch)
methods.description: Handles IVR status updates, triggering corresponding mode switches and event callbacks.

methods.name: _handle_mode_action(self, match: PatternMatch)
methods.description: Detects mode change commands and switches between conversation and IVR modes accordingly.

methods.name: _handle_conversation(self)
methods.description: Emits an event indicating detection of a human conversation with current context.

methods.name: _handle_ivr_detected(self)
methods.description: Switches to IVR mode, updating the context and VAD parameters, and emits detection event.

methods.name: _handle_ivr_completed(self)
methods.description: Signals the completion of IVR navigation via event callback.

methods.name: _handle_ivr_stuck(self)
methods.description: Signals that IVR navigation is stuck and awaits external handling.

methods.name: _handle_ivr_wait(self)
methods.description: Indicates waiting for further transcription or options in IVR navigation, no explicit event.

methods.name: __init__ (IVRProcessor)
methods.description: Initializes the IVR response handler with prompts and VAD settings.

methods.name: __init__ (IVRNavigator)
methods.description: Sets up the IVR navigation pipeline with LLM service, prompts, event handlers, and mode detection.

methods.name: process_frame (IVRNavigator)
methods.description: Intercepts context frames to synchronize conversation history with IVR processor.

methods.name: add_event_handler(self, event_name: str, handler)
methods.description: Registers external callback functions for IVR detection and status change events.
